### Create Account Pipeline

```mermaid
graph TD

A["Add CDN URL"] --> B["Confirm CDN Exists"] --> C["Create Account"] --> D["Copy Private Token"] --> E["Copy Public UUID"]
```

### Example CDN:

```
https://cdn.example.com/us-east-1/profile.yaml
```

App should load `profile.yaml` with versioning (`?v=n`). Media should have versioning added via user's end in their own yaml file.

### Example UUIDv7:

```
019ff9de-2bc6-7a31-b6f4-8c0d19e7a452
```
